invention.ref: Robert Plath develops the upright two-wheel Rollaboard with a collapsible handle in Florida
invention.ref_zh: Robert Plath 在佛罗里达州制作两轮、可伸缩拉杆的直立式 Rollaboard

locations.place_label_zh: 美国佛罗里达州博卡拉顿（Plath 的 Rollaboard）

sources.title: The history of rolling luggage — Travelpro

notes: 本条以现代直立式伸缩拉杆箱为范围。更早已有带轮行李设计，Sadow 的1972年专利采用脚轮与拖带；1987年是Plath式改良的节点，不代表所有带轮行李的最早发明。
notes_en: This entry follows the modern upright case with a collapsible handle. Earlier wheeled luggage existed, including Sadow’s 1972 caster-and-strap patent; 1987 marks Plath’s design, not the first luggage on wheels.
summary_zh: 1987 年飞行员 Robert Plath 将双轮与可伸缩拉杆结合，制作直立拖行的 Rollaboard。这种适合机组人员的设计逐渐走入旅客日常。
summary_en: In 1987 pilot Robert Plath combined two wheels and a collapsible handle in an upright Rollaboard, a design that spread from flight crews to travelers.
